experiment: 15N R1, R2 (CPMG, refocusing time 650 us) at 500 and 700 MHz (printed as 11.7 and 16.1 T; 16.4 T elsewhere); {1H}-15N NOE at 500 MHz; model-free analysis with axially anisotropic tumbling
construct_or_mutation: CsPinA (C. symbiosum PinA, 92 residues + GPMGS N-terminal remnant after PreScission cleavage), 0.8 mM 13C,15N-labeled
other_conditions: regime (authors): conformational exchange on a microsecond to millisecond time scale; tumbling: tau_R = 6.7 ± 0.1 ns, D_par = (4.09 ± 0.08) 10^7 s-1, D_perp = (1.70 ± 0.04) 10^7 s-1; mean R1 2.05 and 1.50 s-1, mean R2 9.40 and 11.21 s-1 at 11.7 and 16.4 T; mean NOE 0.75 at 11.7 T; relaxation data for 79 backbone amides; related structures: 2RQS (deposited free-protein ensemble; numbering offset +5 in the PDB file), 1PIN, 1JNS, 1ZK6 (comparison parvulins)
author_claim: Only the stretch comprising 3_10-helix III and the following turn (G42-G49) shows significant micro- to millisecond mobility (elevated Rex, elevated R1R2 product) and structural heterogeneity in the NMR ensemble; the rest of the structured protein is rigid (weighted mean S2 0.88 ± 0.04 for secondary-structure residues vs 0.87 ± 0.05 overall).
anchor: Large Rex values for Gly 42 , Gly 43 , Ser 44 , Ala 45 , Lys 46 , Asp 48 , and Gly 49 at 11.7 T were equal to 1.8 ± 0.7 s −1 , 1.7 ± 0.4 s −1 , 3.5 ± 0.2 s −1 , 3.7 ± 0.3 s −1 , 3.5 ± 0.2 s −1 , 1.7 ± 0.6 s −1 , and 2.1 ± 0.1 s −1 , respectively.
